start.title: Wer hat gesündigt?
start.text:
Du sitzt im Staub und bettelst.
Jünger fragen: „Wer hat gesündigt?“

curse_consequence.title: Sei still
curse_consequence.text:
Wut wird dich nicht heilen.
Höre zu.

beg_consequence.title: Jetzt still
beg_consequence.text:
Eine Stimme antwortet ihnen.
Höre zu.

reveal.title: Gottes Werke offenbart
reveal.text:
„Weder dieser Mann noch seine Eltern.“
„Gottes Werke sollen sichtbar werden.“

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Hold On
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His voice is kind.
Hope a little.

mud.title: [TODO:de] Mud on Your Eyes
mud.text:
[TODO:de] He spits on the ground, makes clay.
His hand finds your face.

pull_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Still
pull_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His touch is gentle.
Let him work.

wipe_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Trust His Hand
wipe_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Do not undo his work.
Wait.

send.title: [TODO:de] Go to Siloam
send.text:
[TODO:de] "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam."
The way is long.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You feel the wall, and go.

wash.title: [TODO:de] The Pool of Siloam
wash.text:
[TODO:de] Water in your hands.
You bring it to your eyes.

shut_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Open Your Eyes
shut_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He sent you to see.
Lift them.

see.title: [TODO:de] You Can See
see.text:
[TODO:de] Sky. Stone. Your own hands.
You weep, laughing.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Speak Out
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Do not hide his work.
Tell them.

pharisees.title: [TODO:de] Pharisees Question You
pharisees.text:
[TODO:de] They glare. "Who opened your eyes?"
The room is cold.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Speak Truth
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Truth set you free.
Name him.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Find Your Voice
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He gave you sight.
Give him your words.

testify.title: [TODO:de] One Thing I Know
testify.text:
[TODO:de] "I was blind. Now I see."
The light stays with you.
